<mxfile host="Electron"> <diagram id="a2a-summary" name="A2A Visual Summary"> <mxGraphModel grid="0" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="0" page="0" pageScale="1" pageWidth="1000" pageHeight="520" math="0" shadow="0" adaptiveColors="auto"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <mxCell id="title" parent="1" style="text;html=1;align=left;whiteSpace=wrap;fontSize=24;fontColor=#18343B;fontStyle=1;" value="A2A: discover, then call the remote agent
The Agent Card is metadata, not a task-sending actor or an authorization grant." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="80" width="920" x="40" y="20" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="agentA" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#E2F1EE;strokeColor=#76A99E;fontSize=16;" value="Caller agent / client
select binding
authenticate request
consume result" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="160" width="240" x="60" y="200" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="card" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#E9EDF7;strokeColor=#9AA8C2;fontSize=16;" value="Agent Card
endpoint + skills
bindings + auth declarations
no secrets" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="120" width="240" x="390" y="120" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="agentB" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFF0E8;strokeColor=#D99B76;fontSize=16;" value="Remote agent
enforce access
execute request
return result / task status" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="160" width="240" x="700" y="200" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e1" edge="1" parent="1" source="agentA" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;html=1;endArrow=block;strokeWidth=2;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;" target="card" value="Discover metadata"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e2" edge="1" parent="1" source="agentA" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;html=1;endArrow=block;strokeWidth=2;exitX=1;exitY=0.7;entryX=0;entryY=0.7;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;" target="agentB" value="Request (JSON-RPC or HTTP+JSON)"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e3" edge="1" parent="1" source="agentB" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;html=1;endArrow=block;strokeWidth=2;exitX=0.5;exitY=1;entryX=0.5;entryY=1;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;" target="agentA" value="Response / stream / status"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <Array as="points"> <mxPoint x="820" y="440" /> <mxPoint x="180" y="440" /> </Array> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
